name: Digit
summary: A warehouse-focused bipedal robot from Agility Robotics, an Oregon State University spin-off. Digit grew out of the Cassie ostrich-legged research platform by adding a torso, arms and sensing. It moves tote bins and unloads trailers, has run paid pilots with GXO and Amazon, and in 2023 Agility opened 'RoboFab', a factory built specifically to mass-produce it.
notable: Among the first humanoids sold for real warehouse work
